examples.title: Elwynn Forest
examples.text: Elwynn Forest is the verdant heartland of the Kingdom of Stormwind, providing the capital with essential timber, gold, fish, and crops.

examples.title: Goldshire
examples.text: Goldshire is a vital human crossroads town nestled in central Elwynn Forest, connecting Stormwind City with Westfall, Redridge, and the southern frontier.

examples.title: Razor Hill
examples.text: Razor Hill is the principal Horde settlement in central Durotar, nestled at the strategic crossroads between the Valley of Trials, the Barrens, and Orgrimmar.

examples.title: Darkshore
examples.text: Darkshore is a cold, mist-shrouded strip of coast lining northwestern Kalimdor, dotted with ancient Kaldorei ruins and troubled wildlife.

examples.title: Cairne Bloodhoof
examples.text: Cairne Bloodhoof is the venerable High Chieftain of the united tauren tribes and ruler of Thunder Bluff.

examples.title: Durotar
examples.text: Durotar is the arid, red-rock homeland founded by Warchief Thrall following the Third War, named in honor of his father, Durotan.

examples.title: Great Forge
examples.text: The Great Forge is the fiery heart and namesake of the dwarven capital of Ironforge.

examples.title: Crossroads
examples.text: The Crossroads is the beating heart of Horde travel through central Kalimdor, situated where the north-south Gold Road intersects the path from Ratchet to the Stonetalon Mountains.

examples.title: Wanted: "Hogger"
examples.text: A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn. He has overpowered all attempts at his capture. The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.

examples.title: Your Place In The World
examples.text: Finally, you are of age, friend... Of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief. Yes... You will do nicely.

examples.title: Rude Awakening
examples.text: About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it. I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.
examples.speaker: forsaken-male

examples.title: Schlingendorntal
examples.text: Das Schlingendorntal ist ein ungezähmter, dichter Dschungel, der die Südspitze der Östlichen Königreiche südlich des Dämmerwalds dominiert.

examples.title: Teldrassil
examples.text: Teldrassil, qui signifie « Couronne de la terre », est un nouvel Arbre-Monde gargantuesque dressé au large de la côte nord-ouest de Kalimdor.

examples.title: Costa Oscura
examples.text: Costa Oscura es una fría franja costera envuelta en niebla que bordea el noroeste de Kalimdor, salpicada de antiguas ruinas kaldorei y fauna perturbada.

examples.title: Edwin VanCleef
examples.text: Edwin VanCleef fue el brillante maestre del gremio de los Albañiles que reconstruyó Ciudad de Ventormenta tras la Segunda Guerra.

examples.title: Стормвінд
examples.text: Стормвінд — гамірна столиця королівства Стормвінд і найбільший оплот людей у світі після падіння Лордерона.

examples.title: Дуротар
examples.text: Дуротар — засушливая родина из красных скал, основанная вождем Траллом после Третьей войны и названная в честь его отца, Дуротана.

examples.title: Marche Occidentali
examples.text: Un tempo fertile granaio del Regno di Roccavento, le Marche Occidentali sono crollate in un territorio ventoso e trascurato, invaso dai fuorilegge.
